ui.presence.unknown.description: Neutral inline word for an unreported conversation count OR an unknown last-contact age. Not a measured zero; no placeholders.

ui.presence.link_down_last_seen.description: Screen-reader status and sidebar tooltip after an observed unanswered peer link. age is an already-formatted relative-time fragment, e.g. 4m ago; do not format it again.

ui.presence.device_link_down.description: Mesh conversation notice for an observed unanswered peer. reason is verbatim backend diagnostic text; age is an already-formatted relative-time fragment. Preserve both placeholders.

ui.presence.device_unreachable.description: Fallback diagnostic fragment when an observed unanswered peer supplied no reason. Used as the reason argument in the Mesh link-loss notice.

ui.presence.just_now.description: Relative last-contact age under one minute. Short neutral fragment inserted into a larger sentence; no placeholders.

ui.presence.minutes_ago.description: Compact relative last-contact age. count is a nonnegative whole number of elapsed minutes, ICU number-formatted. Keep the unit compact for narrow sidebar rows.

ui.presence.hours_ago.description: Compact relative last-contact age. count is a nonnegative whole number of elapsed hours, ICU number-formatted. Keep the unit compact for narrow sidebar rows.

ui.presence.days_ago.description: Compact relative last-contact age. count is a nonnegative whole number of elapsed days, ICU number-formatted. Keep the unit compact for narrow sidebar rows.

ui.presence.link_down_compact.description: Compact visible sidebar trailing fact after an unanswered peer link. age is an already-formatted relative-time fragment, e.g. 4m ago. Full last-seen wording is provided separately in the accessible name and tooltip.
